name: Yeast
overview: Scripture consistently emphasizes the removal of yeast (leaven) as a symbol of purity and separation from sin, as seen in the commands during the Feast of Unleavened Bread where all leaven must be removed from homes to avoid being cut off from Israel (Exodus 12:15, 12:19; 13:7). Leaven is also prohibited in offerings to the Lord, underscoring its association with impurity and unholiness (Leviticus 2:11; 6:17). However, Amos 4:5 presents a unique instance where offering sacrifice with leaven is linked to the people’s misguided affection, indicating that yeast can symbolize influence or corruption contrary to God’s holiness.
